labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3b part B), test video: scoring only. Times = video time from the first shown frame (uwid.video frame index / 30).
rule: event frame = first frame whose centre shows the other side of the surface; crossing = frames in between (sheet of water / foam). Stepped at 0.2 s (every 6th frame) around each surfacing, 1 s elsewhere in the window, so event times are good to about 0.2 s.
